Slop Resize

Resize pictures and videos. Nothing uploaded.

Drop pictures or videos here

JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF pictures, and MP4, WebM or MOV video. Many at once. Each file is read and resized in this browser and never uploaded.

Originals are never changed. Results are copies: download them, or save them to the Slop Resize folder in Slop Drive. Keys: Ctrl+O open, Ctrl+Enter resize, Esc cancel, Ctrl+S zip.

    Size

    A side left at 0 follows the picture.

    Letterbox colour

    Pictures only. JPEG, WebP and AVIF lower their quality to fit; PNG cannot.

    Output

    Saved settings

    Saved in Slop Drive, in the Slop Resize folder. Without Slop Drive they stay in this browser.
